sozlesme.hukukiNot: This is not a secure electronic signature within the meaning of Turkish Law No. 5070; it is a record of simple electronic consent between the parties.

imza.cizimIstegeBagli: Optional: draw your signature in the box with a mouse, finger or pen.
imza.kayitBilgisi: With the signature we record your name, the time, a digest of your IP address (not the address itself), browser information and the SHA-256 digest of the text. Once signed, the text cannot be changed.
imza.onayKutusu: I have read and accept the contract text.
imza.tuvalIpucu: Draw your signature inside the box.

sablon.bos: No templates yet; the default template is used.

sayfa.bulunamadiMetin: The link may be wrong or removed. Contact us and we will send a new one.
sayfa.iptal: This contract or its signing link was cancelled.
sayfa.suresiDoldu: The signing link has expired. Contact us for a new link.

yonetim.aciklama: Prepare contracts from a template or an accepted quote and send them for signature with a link that needs no login. A signed text cannot be changed; editing opens a new version.
yonetim.birKezUyari: This link will not be shown again. If it gets lost, “Send again” creates a new one and the old one stops working.
yonetim.epostaGitti: The link was e-mailed to the counterparty.
yonetim.imzaliDuzenlemeUyari: A signed contract cannot be changed; saving opens a new version (draft).
yonetim.iptalOnay: Cancel {{no}}? A pending signing link also stops working.
